answers.valueEn: The car is an import. Scratches on the body, especially the roof, trunk, and hood. Paint touch-ups on the door and rear right fender with scratch marks. Broken underbody shields (right and left) and gearbox shield. Broken wheel arch liners (front right and left) and bumper lip. Missing front fog light covers, replaced with parts of AC condensers fixed with screws (modified front bumper / signs of disassembly of the front mask). Slight crack in the front bumper grille.
